title: Testing insulation resistance
summary: Outlines the basic settings and acceptable reading for insulation resistance testing and the three insulation resistance tests to be carried out.

sections.heading: Equipment and settings
paragraphs: Insulation resistance is tested with a high reading ohmmeter set on the megohms scale. Be careful of the voltage used.
bullets: Set it on the megohms (MΩ) scale

sections.heading: Test voltage and acceptable reading
paragraphs: The standard test voltage is 500 V dc, although it can be lowered to 250 V dc. An acceptable reading is above 1 MΩ.
bullets: Can be lowered to 250 V dc

sections.heading: The three insulation resistance tests
paragraphs: Three tests are carried out. The first covers the whole installation with all MCBs in the on position. The second is between the live conductors of a circuit. The third is to earth.
bullets: Test 1: insulation resistance test of the whole installation, with all MCBs in the on position
Test 2: insulation resistance test between live conductors of a circuit
Test 3: insulation resistance test to earth

quiz.q: What is the standard test voltage for an insulation resistance test?
quiz.why: The standard test uses 500 V dc.

quiz.q: To what value can the insulation resistance test voltage be lowered?
quiz.why: The test voltage can be lowered to 250 V dc.

quiz.q: What reading is acceptable for an insulation resistance test?
quiz.why: An acceptable reading is above 1 MΩ.

quiz.q: Which scale should the ohmmeter be set to for insulation resistance testing?
quiz.why: The high reading ohmmeter is set on the megohms scale.

quiz.q: What condition applies to the MCBs in the insulation resistance test of the whole installation?
quiz.why: Test 1 is carried out on the whole installation with all MCBs in the on position.

quiz.q: Between which points is Test 2 of the insulation resistance tests carried out?
options: Between live conductors of a circuit
The consumer unit and the supply
Neutral and the cpc of different circuits
quiz.why: Test 2 is an insulation resistance test between live conductors of a circuit.

quiz.q: Which instrument is used to measure insulation resistance?
quiz.why: A high reading ohmmeter is used.

quiz.q: What does Test 3 of the insulation resistance tests measure?
quiz.why: Test 3 is the insulation resistance test to earth.
